desc: Ideation: iterate over all possible centers c; for each neighbor v, avail(v) = deg(v)−1; choose x neighbors with largest avail, y = x-th largest avail; kept = 1 + x(1+y); maximize.
Write the complete Python solution: fast input parsing, adjacency + degrees, per-center sort and scan, output N − max_kept.
Verify logic against samples: Sample 1 → 1, Sample 2 → 0, Sample 3 → 3; check edge cases (star graphs, paths, x=1 case where snowflake center is a leaf of the kept star).
